# FreeAudioEffect <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
FreeAudioEffect:Void effect:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `effect` | In | Int32 | required | An effect from [AddAudioEffect](AddAudioEffect). `0` is ignored, anything else that is not an effect is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Takes an effect out of the chain of its bus and frees it. A reverb or echo tail that was still ringing is cut. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* Every [audio scene](Audio-Scenes) forgets the effect, so an old scene never changes the effect that gets the same handle later. [FreeAudioBus](FreeAudioBus) frees the effects of the bus too.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
FreeAudioEffect muffle
```
